checklists.title: V Speeds (KIAS) Max Gr. Wt. 2,740 lb

items.prompt: Failure to pull the Landing Gear switch out before up or down can break the switch.
There is no circuit breaker for the Electric trim - note position of the switch instead.
Pitot drain: left wing, forward bottom skin, outboard of root. Static drain: just aft of left wing.
Expect GEAR DOWN, L/R FUEL LOW, VOLTS flashing. Ignore VAC.
Crank 30 sec max; allow several minutes to cool between.
Shutdown leaves throttle at 1100 RPM (< 1/4 in): do not touch.
Expect GEAR DOWN, L/R FUEL LOW, VOLTS flashing. Ignore VAC.
Crank 30 sec max; allow several minutes to cool between.
Fuel Selector - do not switch tank
There is no alternator field switch, check alternator through load only, DO NOT turn of master.
Retarding throttle below 12" MP causes gear warning horn if gear retracted.
Avoid continuous operation between 1500-1950 RPM below 15" MP
Max performance: 65 KIAS final, full flaps, brake max without locking.
Crosswind: approach faster, full flaps (1/2 flaps if crosswind > 12 KTS).
FPI: In LVK Hangar - Nothing Further

checklists.title: Autopilot - Basic Lateral and Vertical Modes
Failure of Landing Gear to Extend Electrically

items.prompt: Do not operate the landing gear electrically with the manual extension system engaged.
Pull T-Handle 1-2 in slowly to engage the drive shaft.
Repeat until gear down and locked. Stop when resistance is felt.
Needs maintenance before electrical gear use.

checklists.title: Failure to Retract Landing Gear Electrically

items.prompt: Indication: GR SAFETY BY PASS light, both gear lights, horn.
If no retraction, check floor manual extension lever position.
Quits on one magneto? Throttle idle and mixture cutoff BEFORE turning magnetos back ON (backfire).
Severe roughness can cause propeller separation. Do not continue unless no alternative.
If smooth on one mag, adjust power and continue.
High temp with normal pressure may be a faulty gauge or thermocouple.
Likely if engine runs only with boost pump ON. Move controls smoothly: lean when reducing power, enrich when adding.
Use if normal static is blocked. Airspeed, altimeter and VSI then read cabin pressure.
NOT AN EMERGENCY. Many fatal accidents began with loss of control closing a door. Return and land.
Have a passenger hold the door in the flare if practicable.
Only If No Return: Close At Safe Alt
Do not operate in known icing conditions.
Gear DOWN: paved or smooth. UP: rough, soft, trees.

items.expectation: ADVANCE SLOWLY TOWARD RICH UNTIL ENGINE STARTS

items.prompt: No restart: best glide, then Forced Landing Without Power.
Gear DOWN: paved or smooth. UP: rough, soft, trees.
If fire persists: faster glide, cowl flaps open, power-off landing. No restart.
Stall warning and gear warning are not available with the Master Switch OFF.
Tripped alternator breaker means a shorted circuit: reset once at most. If it fails, pull the field breaker, shed loads, land ASAP.
Hold wheel firmly when disconnecting: up to 45 lb of force may be needed to hold level.
Max altitude loss: cruise/climb/descent 400 ft; maneuvering/approach 90 ft.
2,000+ fpm at 195 KIAS (gear, flaps up) or 132 KIAS (gear down). 132 is steeper, smoother, lower workload.
Intentional spins are prohibited. Up to 2,000 feet of altitude may be lost in a one-turn spin and recovery.
Hold anti-spin controls until rotation stops.
